🏆 Pet Event Winners


#


The Pet Event has ended! Thank you to everyone who shared their Character + Pet duos with the community. Congratulations to our winners:


- 🥇 **1st place (2,000 Credits):** 3uhmii
- 🥈 **2nd place (1,000 Credits):** @Mr.XD
- 🥉 **3rd place (500 Credits):** @Rudinn #1 lover


Winners, please check your Discord messages to claim your credits. Stay tuned for the[next Redbean event](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/redbean-challenge-the-ocs-hangout) !


---


What if your favourite character had a pet of their own?


This Pet Event is your chance to[create a Character + Pet duo](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/ai-anime-oc-maker-create-your-first-original-character) in Redbean and show the community what they’d be like together — cute, chaotic, funny, or legendary.

###


🎮 How to join (3 easy steps)


#


1. Create a pet for your favourite character in Redbean.
2. Take a screenshot or video of your duo in the game.
3. Share your creation in the[Redbean Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1238136326046482622/1547570503655358464) .


Ready to enter? Share your duo in Discord:


[Join Discord — Share Your Duo](https://discord.com/channels/1238136326046482622/1547570503655358464)


###


🏆 Prizes


#


The top 3 entries with the most reactions will win:


- 🥇 2,000 Credits
- 🥈 1,000 Credits
- 🥉 500 Credits


**📌 Rules**


- Multiple entries are allowed, but each participant can only win once.
- By entering, you allow Redbean to feature your submission with credit.
- Winners are determined by Discord reactions (voters).


Go make the cutest, funniest duo ever — we can’t wait to see your creations!
